extDescription.message: Keeps your bookmarks identical in Chrome, Brave, Edge and Firefox, with backups in your own Google Drive.
extDescription.description: Store listing summary; Chrome Web Store allows at most 132 characters.

popupIntro.message: Link your Google account to keep bookmarks identical in every browser where Marksync is installed.

privacyNote.message: Bookmarks are stored only in a Marksync folder in your own Google Drive. Marksync cannot see any other file there.

syncOff.message: Sync is off in this browser

syncOffHint.message: Sync is turned off for this browser in Settings.

skippedItems_one.message: {1} item not supported in this browser

skippedItems_other.message: {1} items not supported in this browser

massDeleteRemote.message: {1} of {2} bookmarks were deleted in another browser or directly in Google Drive. Sync is paused until you decide. A backup is taken before anything is deleted here.

massDeleteLocal.message: {1} of {2} bookmarks were removed in this browser. Sync is paused so they are not deleted everywhere by mistake.

errNetwork.message: Google Drive could not be reached. Marksync will try again.

badgePaused.message: sync is paused, open it to decide

welcomeConnect.message: To start, connect your Google account below. Do the same in every browser where you install Marksync, with the same Google account.

welcomeNoDuplicates.message: Bookmarks that are already in several browsers are matched, not duplicated.

deviceNameHelp.message: Shown in backups and in the import list of your other browsers. Leave it empty to use the detected name.

syncIntervalLabel.message: Check for changes from other browsers every

syncHelp.message: Changes made in this browser are sent within about a second. Changes from your other browsers arrive as soon as you switch to this browser, and otherwise at the interval above.

restoreHelp.message: Restoring replaces the bookmarks in every connected browser. The current bookmarks are backed up first, so you can undo a restore. To bring back only some bookmarks or folders, open History.

backupReasonBeforeRemoteDelete.message: before a large deletion from another browser

confirmRestore.message: Replace the bookmarks in all browsers with the backup from {1}?

confirmDeleteBackup.message: Delete this backup from Google Drive?

confirmDisconnect.message:
Stop syncing this browser? Your bookmarks, your Drive files and your other connected browsers stay as they are.

To remove Marksync's access to your Google account in every browser, visit myaccount.google.com/permissions.

importIntro.message: Bring bookmarks from another browser into this one. When sync is on, they then appear in all your browsers.

importModeMerge.message: Merge into my bookmarks and skip the ones I already have

importModeFolder.message: Put them in a new folder

browsersEmpty.message: No other browsers yet. Install Marksync there and connect the same Google account. This works even if sync is turned off in that browser.

browsersOffline.message: Connect your Google account to see your other browsers.

importFileHelp.message: For browsers without Marksync. Export the file there first:

importFileChromium.message: Chrome, Brave, Edge: Bookmark manager → ⋮ → Export bookmarks.

importFileFirefox.message: Firefox: Bookmarks → Manage bookmarks → Import and Backup → Export Bookmarks to HTML.

importFailed_one.message: 1 could not be added in this browser.

importFailed_other.message: {1} could not be added in this browser.

removeBrowserHint.message: Remove a browser you no longer use from this list

confirmRemoveBrowser.message: Remove {1} from this list? Its bookmarks are not touched.

importedFolder.description: Name of the folder an import creates. {1}: source browser or file name, {2}: date.

deviceLabel.description: {1} is the browser name, {2} the operating system, e.g. "Brave on Windows".

errReconnect.message: Reconnect your Google account to keep syncing.

errNoClientId.message: This build has no Google OAuth client ID (WXT_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID). See docs/GOOGLE_SETUP.md.

errSignInState.message: Google sign-in returned an unexpected state.

errDriveNotGranted.message: Google Drive access was not granted. Connect again and allow Drive access.

errOtherAccount.message: Google returned a different account ({1}). Reconnect to continue.

errNewerSyncFile.message: The sync file in Google Drive was written by a newer Marksync. Update the extension.

errNotBackup.message: This file is not a Marksync backup.

errNotSnapshot.message: This file is not a Marksync browser snapshot.

errNoAnswer.message: The background script did not answer.

aiIntro.message: Choose an inbox folder. When you add a bookmark to it in this browser, an AI model picks the best matching folder among yours and moves the bookmark there a few seconds later. The model can run on OpenRouter, on a server you run (Ollama, LM Studio, ...) or on this device.

aiPrivacy.message: Only while this is on: the bookmark's title, its address without the part after "?" and the names of your folders are sent to OpenRouter and the model you choose. With web research on, OpenRouter also opens that address and may search the web for it. Other browsers send nothing unless you turn it on there too.

aiEnabledLabel.message: Sort bookmarks I add to the inbox folder in this browser

aiChooseInbox.message: Choose the inbox folder to start.

aiInboxMissing.message: The inbox folder no longer exists in this browser. Choose another one.

aiReady.message: Ready. Bookmarks you add to "{1}" are sorted a few seconds later.

aiKeyNone.message: No key saved. You can create one at openrouter.ai/keys.

aiKeyHelp.message: The key is stored only in this browser and is never uploaded to Google Drive.

aiKeyInvalid.message: This does not look like an OpenRouter API key.

aiConfirmRemoveKey.message: Remove the OpenRouter API key from this browser? AI sorting stops until you add a key again.

aiModelHelp.message: Pick a model from OpenRouter's list or type any model ID. The default {1} is the most thorough; Sonnet or Gemini Flash are faster and cheaper.

aiAllowNewLabel.message: Create a new folder when none of mine fits

aiSortNowResult.message: Moved {1}, left in the inbox {2}, failed {3}. Details are in the sorting log.

aiNotReady.message: Turn on AI sorting, choose an inbox folder and finish setting up the AI provider first.

aiPermissionMissing.message: Marksync is not allowed to contact openrouter.ai. Turn AI sorting off and on again to allow it.

aiPermissionDenied.message: AI sorting needs permission to contact openrouter.ai.

aiNoKey.message: Save an OpenRouter API key first.

aiUndoHint.message: Move the bookmark back to the inbox

aiUndoMoved.message: The bookmark was moved again since then, so it stays where it is.

aiUndoNoSource.message: The inbox folder no longer exists.

aiLogIntro.message: Every decision the AI made in this browser, newest first. The last {1} are kept.

aiLogConfirmClear.message: Delete the whole sorting log? Bookmarks are not changed.

aiLogEmpty.message: Nothing here yet. Bookmarks you add to the inbox folder will show up here once the AI has filed them.

aiLogTotals.message: {1} moved · {2} left in the inbox · {3} failed

aiErrRateLimit.message: Too many requests to OpenRouter. Try again later.

aiErrModel.message: The model is unavailable or rejected the request. Check the model ID in Settings.

aiErrReply.message: The AI's answer could not be used, so the bookmark stayed in the inbox.

aiResearchLabel.message: Research the site on the web before sorting

aiResearchHelp.message: The model reads the bookmarked page and searches the web when needed, then describes what the site is and what it is used for. More accurate, but slower (often 10–60 seconds) and a little more expensive.

dupIntro.message: Pages bookmarked more than once, even when the copies differ only in http or https, a trailing slash, or tracking parameters such as utm_source. Choose the copy to keep; the others are removed in every browser.

dupSettingHelp.message: Find pages you bookmarked more than once and keep one copy of each.

dupConfirm.message: Remove {1} bookmarks? They are removed in every browser that syncs with Marksync. A backup is saved to Google Drive first.

dupConfirmNoBackup.message: Remove {1} bookmarks from this browser? Marksync is not connected to Google Drive, so no backup can be saved first.

dupDoneBackup.message: A backup was saved to Google Drive first; you can restore it in Settings.

dupSkipped_one.message: 1 was left alone because it changed or was already gone.

dupSkipped_other.message: {1} were left alone because they changed or were already gone.

dupNone.message: No duplicates: every page is bookmarked once.

linkIntro.message: Finds bookmarks whose pages are gone or have moved, and offers the Wayback Machine's saved copy of pages that no longer exist.

linkSettingHelp.message: Check every bookmark and fix the ones that no longer open.

linkStartText.message: Marksync opens the address of every bookmark in the background, a few at a time, and lists the ones that are gone, have moved or gave no clear answer. Nothing changes until you choose a fix.

linkHintSignIn.message: Pages are opened without your cookies, so a page that needs you to be signed in can look missing. Open it before removing it.

linkHintPrivacy.message: This needs access to every site, asked for when you start. Addresses on your own computer or local network are never opened. For pages that are gone, the address is looked up at archive.org.

linkInterrupted.message: The last check stopped after {1} of {2} bookmarks.

linkHelpDead.message: These pages no longer exist or their site cannot be reached. Use the archived copy, or remove the bookmark.

linkHelpMoved.message: These pages open from another address now. Update the bookmark to the new address.

linkHelpUnknown.message: These gave no clear answer: they may need you to be signed in, or the site was busy. Check them again later.

linkConfirmRemoveAll.message: Remove {1} bookmarks whose pages are gone? They are removed in every browser. A backup is saved to Google Drive first when Marksync is connected.

linkConfirmUpdateAll.message: Point {1} bookmarks to the new addresses their pages moved to?

linkPermissionDenied.message: Checking links needs access to every site.

linkPermissionMissing.message: Marksync is not allowed to open other sites. Start the check from the link checker page to allow it.

linkChanged.message: This bookmark was changed after the check, so it was left as is. Check again to see its new state.

aiModelToolsHint.message: Can read the page and search the web (Research option)

aiModelNoTools.message: This model can't use tools, so it decides from the title and address only, even with Research on.

aiModelsOffline.message: Turn on AI sorting to load OpenRouter's full model list. Suggested models are shown until then.

aiModelsFailed.message: Could not load the model list: {1}

aiModelsShown.message: Showing {1} of {2} models. Search to narrow the list.

usageFreeTier.message: Free tier: add credits to use paid models.

usageNoLimit.message: This key has no spending limit.

aiErrBudget.message: This month's AI budget is used up, so the bookmark stayed in the inbox.

aiBudgetHelpOff.message: 0 = no cap. AI sorting in this browser spent {1} this month.

aiBudgetHelpOn.message: {1} of {2} spent this month. Sorting pauses when the budget is used up.

aiBudgetHelpOver.message: {1} of {2} spent: sorting is paused until {3}. Raise the budget to continue now.

aiBudgetStopped.message: Stopped: the monthly budget is used up.

usageBudgetNear.message: {1}% of the monthly budget is used.

usageBudgetOver.message: Budget used up: new bookmarks stay in the inbox until {1}.

findMore.message: Showing {1} of {2}. Add a word to narrow it down.

findHint.message: Enter opens in a new tab · Shift+Enter here · Ctrl+Enter in the background · #tag filters by tag

aiBulkIntro.message: The AI proposes a folder for each bookmark already in the folder you choose (up to 100). Nothing moves until you review the list and apply it; every move can be undone on the log page.

aiBulkChooseFolder.message: Choose the folder to sort first.

aiBulkBusy.message: Apply or discard the current proposals first.

aiBulkEmpty.message: This folder has no bookmarks to sort (subfolders are not included).

aiBulkNotReady.message: The proposals are not ready yet.

aiBulkCostHint.message: What OpenRouter charged for this run

aiBulkConfirmDiscard.message: Discard these proposals? Nothing has been moved yet.

aiBulkStoppedCancel.message: Stopped after {1} of {2}. You can apply the proposals so far.

aiBulkDone.message: Moved {1}, {2} could not be moved. Undo any move on the log page.

emailShow.message: Click to show the full address

encIntro.message: Encrypt your bookmarks in Google Drive with a passphrase only you know. Google, and anyone who gets into your Drive, then sees only scrambled data. Each browser asks for the passphrase once.

encStrengthHint.message: At least {1} characters. A few unrelated words make a passphrase that is long and easy to remember.

encStrengthWeak.message: Weak: make it longer or mix in other kinds of characters.

encMismatch.message: The two passphrases are not the same.

encUnderstand.message: I understand that if I forget the passphrase, the encrypted data in Drive (including backups) cannot be recovered. My bookmarks stay in my browsers.

encEnabledToast.message: Encryption is on. Your other browsers will ask for the passphrase.

encLockedText.message: Encryption is on for this account. Enter the passphrase to sync this browser; until then nothing is uploaded from here.

encOnWhat.message: Encrypted: the sync file, every backup and the bookmark lists of your browsers (AES-256-GCM, key from your passphrase with PBKDF2).

encOnNot.message: Not encrypted: file names and dates, and the browser names and bookmark counts shown in the lists.

encOnOthers.message: The passphrase never leaves your browsers; the key is kept only in this browser.

encDisableConfirm.message: Turn off encryption for every browser? Your bookmarks and backups will be stored in Drive unencrypted again.

encResetConfirm.message: This deletes the encrypted sync file, encrypted backups and browser lists in Drive. They cannot be recovered. Bookmarks in your browsers are not touched, and sync starts again from this browser. Type {1} to continue.

encResetDone.message: Encryption was reset: {1} encrypted files deleted. Sync starts again from this browser.

encAlreadyOn.message: Encryption is already on for this account. Enter the passphrase to unlock it.

encPassphraseShort.message: The passphrase must have at least {1} characters.

errLocked.message: Encryption is on: enter the passphrase in Settings to sync this browser.

errDecrypt.message: A file in Drive could not be decrypted. It may have been changed outside Marksync.

errEncryptionFile.message: The encryption settings in Drive (encryption.json) are damaged.

aiProviderHelpOpenRouter.message: Hundreds of models, web research, costs a little per bookmark. Needs an OpenRouter API key.

aiProviderHelpCustom.message: Free and private: Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp or any OpenAI-compatible address. No web research.

aiProviderHelpBuiltin.message: Free, offline, nothing leaves this device. Chrome downloads a small model once. No web research, and fewer folders are offered.

aiPrivacyCustom.message: Only while this is on: the bookmark's title, its address without the part after "?" and the names of your folders are sent to {1}. Nothing is sent to OpenRouter. Other browsers send nothing unless you turn it on there too.

aiPrivacyBuiltin.message: The model runs on this device: the bookmark's title, address and your folder names never leave this computer.

aiEndpointHelp.message: The base address of the OpenAI-compatible API, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama or http://localhost:1234/v1 for LM Studio. Marksync asks for permission to contact this address only.

aiEndpointInsecure.message: Saved: {1}. This address is not encrypted (http) and not on your network: use https for a server on the internet.

aiEndpointSavedToast.message: Address saved. Marksync may now contact {1}.

aiEndpointInvalid.message: Enter an http or https address without a user name, "?" or "#", e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1.

aiEndpointTestOk_other.message: Connected. The server offers {1} models; pick one under Model.

aiEndpointTestNoModels.message: Connected, but the server listed no models. Enter the model name yourself.

aiEndpointModelHelp.message: The model name as the server knows it, e.g. llama3.2:3b or qwen3:8b. "Test" above lists the models the server offers.

aiEndpointModelInvalid.message: Enter the model name as the server lists it (letters, digits and . : / @ + - _).

aiEndpointKeyNone.message: No key saved. Local servers usually need none.

aiEndpointKeyHelp.message: Sent as a Bearer token to the address above only. Stored in this browser only, never uploaded to Google Drive.

aiEndpointKeyRejected.message: The server rejected the key. Check the key, or remove it if the server needs none.

historyOpenHint.message: Compare this backup with your bookmarks now and bring back single items

historyNoBackups.message: There are no backups yet. Make one in Settings, or wait for the scheduled backup.

tidyIntro.message: The AI looks at your whole folder structure (or one folder) and proposes merging folders that mean the same thing, renaming unclear folders and cleaning cryptic bookmark titles; empty folders are found too. Nothing changes until you review the list and apply it. A backup is made first, and every change can be undone on the log page.

tidyEstimateUnknown_other.message: {1} requests; the price of this model is unknown.

tidyConfirmStart.message: Ask the AI for a tidy-up plan? {1} Nothing changes until you apply it.

tidyWaiting.message: The AI is looking at your folders and titles…

tidyConfirmApply.message: Apply {1} change(s)? Your bookmarks are backed up first, and each change can be undone on the log page.

tidyConfirmApplyNoBackup.message: Apply {1} change(s)? Not connected to Google Drive, so no backup is made first; each change can still be undone on the log page.

tidyNothing.message: The AI found nothing to tidy up.

tidyCancelled.message: Stopped. The proposals so far can still be applied.

digestSettingHelp.message: The popup shows a few bookmarks you have not opened in a long time, some related to what you saved lately. Made from what is already in this browser; nothing is sent anywhere.

digestKept.message: Kept; it will not come back for a while

digestConfirmDelete.message: Delete the bookmark "{1}" in every browser?

digestGone.message: This bookmark is no longer there.

semIntro.message: Find bookmarks by what they are about, even when the words differ ("how to make dough rise" finds "Bread baking basics"). Each bookmark is turned into a vector once; the index is shared with your other browsers through Google Drive, and only new or changed bookmarks are sent again.

semEnabledLabel.message: Search by meaning in the popup

semPrivacy.message: When you build the index, the title, the address without the part after "?", what AI sorting found out about the site and the tags of each synced bookmark are sent to the AI provider chosen above (OpenRouter or your own server). Each search by meaning sends the query.

semModelHelpOpenRouter.message: Empty: {1}. Any embedding model on OpenRouter works; changing it builds a new index.

semModelHelpCustom.message: The embedding model on your server, e.g. nomic-embed-text or mxbai-embed-large on Ollama. Changing it builds a new index.

semPendingFree_one.message: 1 bookmark to index, free with your server.

semPendingFree_other.message: {1} bookmarks to index, free with your server.

semPendingCost_other.message: {1} bookmarks to index, about {2} on OpenRouter.

semOff.message: Turn on search by meaning first.

semInterrupted.message: The browser stopped Marksync while indexing. Update the index to continue.

semSearchHint.message: Find bookmarks about this, even with other words (Alt+Enter)

namingIntro.message: Choose one or more folders: the AI looks at every bookmark in them (with web research on OpenRouter it reads each page) and proposes a clear title that says what the site is and what it is for. You can edit every proposal before saving; nothing changes until you apply. A backup is made first, and every rename can be undone on the log page.

namingResearch.message: Read each page (slower, more accurate, costs more)

namingUiLanguage.message: Write the titles in my language

namingChooseFolder.message: Tick at least one folder first.

namingEmpty.message: The chosen folders have no bookmarks to name.

namingConfirmStart.message: Ask the AI for new titles? {1} Nothing changes until you apply them.

namingNothing.message: The AI found every title clear already.

namingWaiting.message: The AI is naming the bookmarks…

namingWaitingResearch.message: The AI is reading the pages and naming them…

namingEditHint.message: Click a title to change it; it is saved as you leave the box.

namingConfirmApply.message: Rename {1} bookmark(s)? Your bookmarks are backed up first, and each rename can be undone on the log page.

namingConfirmApplyNoBackup.message: Rename {1} bookmark(s)? Not connected to Google Drive, so no backup is made first; each rename can still be undone on the log page.

namingInvalid.message: A title needs at least 2 characters (at most 120).

assistantImported_one.message: An AI assistant proposed 1 change: review it under Tidy up the library.

assistantImported_other.message: An AI assistant proposed {1} changes: review them under Tidy up the library.

storageDrive.message: Google Drive (your own Drive, the Marksync folder).

webdavSummary.message: Use a WebDAV server instead (Nextcloud, ownCloud, a NAS…)

webdavHelp.message: Marksync keeps the same files there as in Drive (a Marksync folder with the sync file, backups and browser lists), with end-to-end encryption if you turn it on. Use the WebDAV address of a folder you own, e.g. https://cloud.example.org/remote.php/dav/files/USER/ on Nextcloud. Every browser that should sync needs the same address.

webdavPrivacy.message: Use an app password (Nextcloud: Settings → Security → Devices & sessions). It is stored in this browser only and sent only to this server.

webdavConfirmSwitch.message: Switch this browser from its current storage to this WebDAV server? Its bookmarks stay as they are and are synced with what is on the server.

webdavInvalidUrl.message: Enter an http or https address without a user name, "?" or "#".

webdavMissingLogin.message: Enter the user name and the app password.

webdavAuthFailed.message: The server refused the user name or password.

webdavNotFound.message: There is no folder at this address on the server.

webdavNotDav.message: This address does not speak WebDAV. Check the address (on Nextcloud it ends in /remote.php/dav/files/USER/).

sharedIntro.message: Share a bookmark folder with family or a team. It gets its own sync file in your Google Drive, shared with their Google accounts; their changes reach you and yours reach them. There is no Marksync server.

sharedPrivacy.message: Shared folders are not end-to-end encrypted (the others could not read them), even when your own bookmarks are. Editors can change the folder; viewers only see it.

sharedCreateHelp.message: The folder moves into “Marksync Shared” and leaves your personal sync: in your other browsers, join it like the others do.

sharedEmailsPlaceholder.message: Google accounts to invite, e.g. ana@example.org, deniz@example.org

sharedConfirmCreate.message: Share “{1}”? It moves into “Marksync Shared” and stops syncing through your personal sync file.

sharedJoinHelp.message: Open the link from the invitation e-mail first (it lets Marksync read the folder), then paste the code it shows here.

sharedConfirmLeave.message: Stop syncing “{1}” in this browser? The bookmarks stay here as an ordinary folder; nothing changes for the others.

shareNeedsDrive.message: Shared folders work with Google Drive only, not with WebDAV.

shareChooseFolder.message: Choose a folder to share (not a top-level one).

shareAlreadyJoined.message: You have already joined this folder.

shareBadCode.message: That is not a share code or invitation link.

shareNoAccess.message: Marksync may not open this shared folder yet. Open the invitation link first and pick the file there, then try again.

shareNotMarksync.message: This file is not a Marksync shared folder.

shareUnknown.message: This shared folder is not in this browser.

shareFolderGone.message: The shared folder was deleted in this browser. Leave it, then join it again to get it back.

shareLostAccess.message: You no longer have access to this shared folder.
